name: runpublic
description: Project-aware public HTTPS URLs for local development services

scripts.check: node --check cloudflare/src/worker.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/detect.js && node --check src/process-state.js && node --check src/tunnel-client.js && node --check src/edge-server.js && node --check src/naming.js && node --check src/proxy-headers.js && npm test && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply runpublic-production --local --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply runpublic-production --remote --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc

author: Keshav Patil
